flavor.phonemic_palette: Japonic base (open CV moras; vowels a i u e o; rendaku) with a heavy Sino-Japanese (on'yomi) overlay: Chinese loanwords read in Japanese phonology, a court/bureaucratic register; clan(-shi) + given.
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Chinese + Japanese per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Chinese + Japanese register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'ryujin'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Ryujin — wary imperial bureaucracy of the forest; honor, tradition.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Ryujin (Chinese + Japanese) are a assertive imperial bureaucracy people seeded in forest, mountains, swamp. They prize honor, tradition, knowledge, lean toward the military sphere, and field crossbowmen, archers, heavy_infantry. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch wisdom, war, harvest.
